title: Plan jobs whose criteria ask for a 'fails without the fix' run
summary: Retry context: job 20261103-231422-8dzf was rejected because an easy job had a 'fails without the fix' criterion, got no plan, and so no demonstration reached the verifier. In dispatch, a job whose accepted criteria name a failing run without the fix is planned even in `hard` mode when the reading is not hard; ordinary easy jobs still skip planning. The audience is the verifier and the maintainer running the drain.

defaults_applied.how: The change and tests are Rust in athena-core.
New tests for both branches; cargo test and clippy must be clean.
Criteria check a planned job reaching the verifier brief, not wiring.
The final criterion is the outcome check of fmt, clippy and the full test run.
The fix is at the planning gate, not a retry of the one job.
One focused change to the gate plus tests.
The verifier runs the named cargo test commands.
BRIEF.md asks for tagged releases and a changelog, so the change records itself in CHANGELOG.md.

assumptions: Code survey: crates/athena-core/src/run/mod.rs computes `planned` from `job_plan.plans(reading.hard_reason.is_some())` and `!capability.pins_repo()`, then calls `plan_round` (crates/athena-core/src/run/planning.rs); `JobPlanConfig::plans` in crates/athena-data/src/config.rs holds the enabled/mode rule. Demonstrations are run in crates/athena-core/src/run/checks.rs and rendered for the verifier in crates/athena-core/src/verify.rs. The reading's Criterion (crates/athena-data/src/records.rs) has only `text` and `kind`, with no fails_without field; fails_without exists only on the plan's Demonstration, so the trigger is a Behavior criterion whose text names 'fails without the fix' (case-insensitive; also 'fails without the change/mechanism' variants if the producer judges them the same ask). The property is measured directly by running a job through `Athena::go` with the fake agents, as the existing demonstration tests in crates/athena-core/src/run/tests.rs do. No record or data file is added under crates/, so check_record_file, AnyRecord and the round-trip test are untouched. The change adds no refusal rule, only widens planning.

Job 20261103-231422-8dzf: its candidate's work (drain job-limit slot give-back in crates/athena-cli/src/drain.rs, tests/drain.rs, main.rs, and its CHANGELOG.md entry) is a different feature, retried as 20261103-193428-df2m; it is not part of this change and is dropped here. The finding that evidence was missing is addressed at its cause: the planning gate, not the candidate. Its dependency 20261103-231410-asf2 (landed 4 Nov, 64cb889) already runs and shows demonstrations, so it is not touched.
The existing docs/design/job-planning.md section on modes (section 9) is updated to state the new rule; docs/job-planning.md does not exist.
`mode = "all"` and `enabled = false` behave as today: disabled still plans nothing; planning is still skipped for a pinned-repo capability (study).

acceptance_criteria.text: A test in crates/athena-core/src/run/tests.rs (or crates/athena-cli/tests/job_plan.rs) runs an easy job (hard_reason null, `[job_plan] mode = "hard"`) whose Behavior criterion says a test 'fails without the fix': the planner and critic are called, and the verifier prompt contains the 'fails-without-1' record from Athena's revert run. Run `cargo test --locked -p athena-core run::tests` and `cargo test --locked -p athena-cli --test job_plan`.

A test runs an easy job in `hard` mode with no such criterion and asserts no planner or critic call and no plan record, so ordinary easy jobs still skip planning. Run `cargo test --locked -p athena-core run::tests` and `cargo test --locked -p athena-cli --test job_plan`.

The new 'plans' test fails without the fix: with the criterion check in crates/athena-core/src/run/mod.rs reverted to `plans(reading.hard_reason.is_some())` alone, `cargo test --locked -p athena-core run::tests` fails on it.

The planning gate in crates/athena-core/src/run/mod.rs (grep `planned`) also holds when any accepted Behavior criterion text names 'fails without the fix', and the trigger is a small named helper with a doc comment, not inline string matching.
docs/design/job-planning.md (an existing file) and CHANGELOG.md state that a job with a 'fails without the fix' criterion is planned even when judged easy.

Outcome check: `cargo fmt --check`, `cargo clippy --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings` and `cargo test --locked` pass, and the existing mode tests in crates/athena-cli/tests/job_plan.rs still pass unchanged.

out_of_scope: Job 20261103-231422-8dzf's candidate files crates/athena-cli/src/drain.rs, crates/athena-cli/tests/drain.rs and crates/athena-cli/src/main.rs: the drain job-limit work is not part of this change and is dropped here.
Changing how demonstrations are run or shown to the verifier (landed in 64cb889; job 20261103-231410-asf2).
Changing the planner, critic or reader prompts.
Governance files: athena.toml, defaults.toml and workflows; the repository's `mode = "hard"` setting stays.
Adding a fails_without field to the reading's Criterion record.
urgent_reason: It cuts repeated rejected attempts: correct code was rejected three times because the 'fails without the fix' demonstration never ran for an unplanned job.
hard_reason: It changes the run pipeline: the rule deciding which jobs are read, planned and verified, so which jobs get a planner and critic.
